answer: The apartment is child-proofed. For safety, socket covers and stair gates are not standard equipment. However, you can request free electric oil-filled heaters and plug adapters from the front desk. Please ensure your device supports 230 V before plugging it in.
guest_message: Is the apartment child-proofed? Do you have socket covers or stair gates?

[{"source_id":"20.1","title":"Families with children","text":"House manual > 20. Tips for Different Kinds of Guests > 20.1 Families with children

- Ask for the free travel cot or high chair at least 48 hours before arrival (section 15.1).
- Keep balcony doors locked when small children are in the apartment, and never leave children alone on the balcony or terrace.
- Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult in the lifts and on the roof terrace.
- The Two-Bedroom and the Penthouse are the best choices for families because they have separate bedrooms and washing machines.
- Remember that children aged 2 and above count as guests for occupancy and for the extra guest fee (sections 2.1 and 2.2)."},{"source_id":"11.7","title":"Damage and loss","text":"House manual > 11. House Rules > 11.7 Damage and loss

Please report breakages straight away. Accidental breakage of small items (a glass or plate) is not a problem if you tell us. Larger damage or missing items are charged at replacement cost; for direct bookings this is deducted from the security deposit, and for platform bookings we claim through the platform. We take photos of every apartment before each stay."},{"source_id":"2.1","title":"Guest numbers and occupancy","text":"House manual > 2. Booking Rules, Fees and Policies > 2.1 Guest numbers and occupancy

Every apartment has a **base occupancy** and a **maximum occupancy** (see the table in section 1.2). You may never exceed the maximum, even for a few hours. Infants under 2 years old sleep free and do not count as guests. Children aged 2 and above count as guests.

Only guests registered on the booking may stay overnight. If your plans change and more people will sleep in the apartment, tell the host before they arrive so the booking can be updated (subject to the maximum occupancy and to section 2.2)."},{"source_id":"3.4","title":"Guest registration and ID","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.4 Guest registration and ID

Pakistani law and our building rules require us to register every adult guest. Before arrival, every guest aged 18 or over must send:

- **Pakistani nationals:** a clear photo of the CNIC (front and back).
- **Foreign nationals:** a photo of the passport photo page and the visa page.

The host sends an upload link when you book. Please complete it **at least 24 hours before arrival**. The primary guest on the booking must be 21 or older. **Your door code is only released after your ID has been verified** (section 3.5)."}]

[{"source_id":"15.2","title":"Extra heaters and adapters","text":"House manual > 15. Extras and Requests > 15.2 Extra heaters and adapters

Free electric oil-filled heaters (winter) and plug adapters are available from the front desk (sections 7.2 and 5.4)."},{"source_id":"3.8","title":"What is waiting for you","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.8 What is waiting for you

On arrival you will find two 1.5-litre bottles of drinking water, tea bags, instant coffee, sugar and salt, soap and shampoo, toilet paper, dish soap, a bottle of laundry detergent (units with a washing machine), bin bags, and fresh towels (one bath towel per guest plus one extra). Fresh milk is not provided."},{"source_id":"5.4","title":"Power sockets and adapters","text":"House manual > 5. Wi-Fi, TV and Electronics > 5.4 Power sockets and adapters

Pakistan uses 230 volts and 50 Hz. Most sockets in the apartments are universal and accept Type C, D and G plugs. If your plug does not fit, the front desk has free adapters. Please check that your device supports 230 V before you plug it in."},{"source_id":"20.2","title":"Business travellers and remote workers","text":"House manual > 20. Tips for Different Kinds of Guests > 20.2 Business travellers and remote workers

- Every apartment has a desk or dining table and fast Wi-Fi with an automatic 4G backup (section 5.1).
- The generator keeps the Wi-Fi router on during power cuts, but your laptop battery is your own responsibility, and the induction plate and kettle will not work during a cut.
- The front desk can receive parcels and documents for you between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM (section 15.4).
- Quiet hours (10:00 PM to 8:00 AM) apply to video calls on balconies and in corridors."}]

[{"source_id":"12.2","title":"Fire","text":"House manual > 12. Safety and Emergencies > 12.2 Fire

Each apartment has smoke detectors, and a fire extinguisher is in every kitchen and in every corridor. If you hear the alarm or see fire: leave the apartment, close the door, use the **stairs (never the lift)** at Stair A or Stair B, and gather at the front lawn at Gate 1. Call 16 and the security desk."},{"source_id":"10.6","title":"Where things are in the building","text":"House manual > 10. Building Amenities and Accessibility > 10.6 Where things are in the building

- **Ground floor:** lobby and front desk, shared laundry room, the ramp from Gate 2, and the lifts.
- **Basement (B1):** parking, reached by the vehicle ramp from Gate 1 or by lift (press B1).
- **Each residential floor:** two lifts, Stair A and Stair B (fire exits), a trash room at the end of the corridor, and the apartment doors.
- **Roof level (R):** the shared roof terrace with the smoking corner at its north end, reached by lift or by Stair A.
- **Outside:** the front lawn at Gate 1 is the fire assembly point."},{"source_id":"12.6","title":"Security","text":"House manual > 12. Safety and Emergencies > 12.6 Security

Guards are on duty at both gates 24 hours a day. Lock the door whenever you leave the apartment and keep windows and balcony doors locked at night. The building does not accept responsibility for valuables left in the apartment or in the basement."},{"source_id":"10.5","title":"Accessibility","text":"House manual > 10. Building Amenities and Accessibility > 10.5 Accessibility

- The lifts are large enough for a wheelchair (door width 90 cm).
- A ramp leads from Gate 2 to the lobby, and the lobby has no steps to the lifts.
- Apartment entrance doors are 85 cm wide.
- Bathroom doors are 70 cm wide and have a threshold of about 2 cm, and showers have a small step. **The apartments are therefore not fully wheelchair-accessible.** Guests with limited mobility should message the host before booking so we can advise honestly."}]
